title: SvgRect
responsibility: Renders the native rect element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgRect.children
inputs.description: Optional Svelte Snippet; when supplied, it is invoked and rendered inside the <rect>, and when absent no child content is rendered. It is removed from the remaining props, so it is not spread onto the element as an attribute.

outputs.name: SvgRect
outputs.description: Renders an SVG <rect> element and spreads all props other than children onto it; when a children Snippet is supplied, that snippet is rendered inside the element. It adds no wrapper and supplies no default rect attributes.
